title: Held-out prediction of the cancellation coefficient from amplitude coordinates
interpretation_guard: Held-out amplitude coordinates still require observing the held-out orbit vector. This predicts only its cancellation coefficient conditionally on those coordinates.
claim_ceiling: No asymptotic proof and no direct progress toward a proof of Goldbach.

configuration.model: per-modulus outer-fold no-intercept minimum-norm least squares
